name: ultrawork from build switches the session to Sisyphus
hyperplan switches to Prometheus; planner writes the plan, is refused code edits and implementing runs, and its consult is read-only
Atlas without a plan is read-only
other lanes cannot rewrite a plan
start-work with an unknown plan starts nothing
start-work switches to Atlas and runs each ticket in a fresh Atlas session, then both reviews and the accept gate
/goal switches to Hephaestus, keeps the session's non-GPT model, and loops until update_goal complete
a goal that makes no progress pauses after three idle turns
